description: Basic end-to-end eval golden set for Mirae SIF PoC. Current-state answers are evaluated as of 2026-07-23. Notice-cum-Addendum SIF/05/2026, dated 2026-06-29 and effective 2026-07-01, supersedes the affected ISID/KIM provisions for accredited minimum application, SIP, SWP, and exit load; all unaffected provisions remain sourced from the ISID and official Platinum SIF material. Categories: fact (exact numbers must match), descriptive (pattern match), colloquial (no 'SIF' keyword - tests scope pinning), trap (must refuse gracefully).
